summary: A young man tackles an overhang bouldering route in a climbing gym, traversing horizontally across colored holds before dropping down and walking past the camera.

people.description: Young East Asian man with dark wavy hair, wearing a grey ribbed tank top and baggy light blue jeans. A second man in a black t-shirt briefly walks in front of the lens near the end.

quality.issues: A passerby briefly walks across the foreground around 31s.

moments.action: Climber starts on the overhang wall, establishing his footing and starting the traverse
Climber extends along the steep overhang holds with strong core tension
good_for: holding on when it gets hard

moments.action: Climber executes a wide heel-hook and reaches across towards the right side of the wall
Climber drops off the wall, recovers his breath, and walks directly toward the camera
good_for: walking away after a hard session
